scope: The literal 8490-slot controller starts with an empty heap and the original self-delimited capacity, adjacency and demand source. The actual parser and matrix projection preserve all returned roots and hand them directly to the actual vertex generation, metadata, parameter, initialization and fuel-iteration solver on the same heap. For positive graph order, it returns every field and event of the old solveInput state, preserves the unused source suffix and exact request stream, and pays its final halt. Forty-five default-budget monotonicity lemmas derive an explicit composed original-source-length envelope from N alone, removing supplied heap, vertex, label, width, parameter and fuel certificates. Two physical bit-interpreter cases and two larger natural-reference cases are distinguished. Valid typed graph/source encoding and positive order remain the theorem domain; arbitrary malformed input, outer degenerate dispatch and the full paper runtime remain separate.
